description: Cross-SDK golden corpus for the fleet wire format (Deep-004 / PR-020). Every Python/Go/TypeScript SDK validates its JSON number handling, response-envelope unwrapping, error-envelope mapping, pagination token shape, fork-receipt fields, and WS broadcast frame shapes against these exact vectors, so a wire-format regression in one SDK fails loudly in all three.

http_envelope.note: Fleet responses wrap the payload under `data`; SDKs unwrap it transparently (and return the raw value when there is no `data` object).

error_envelope.note: PR-021: gateway errors are typed envelopes; the SDK surfaces the HTTP status + message.

arbitrary_precision.note: sonic-rs wraps numbers > i64/u64 or unusual values as {"$sonic_rs::private::JsonNumber":"…"}. Python unwraps to int, Go to int64/float64, TypeScript to bigint (never a silently rounded Number). Values past Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER must NOT be silently rounded.

pagination.note: PR-008: multi-instance continuation is an opaque map instance_id -> token; SDKs must preserve the full map and never collapse it to a single token.

fork_receipt.note: ForkReceipt carries immutable provenance: child + source channel, source state version, boundary cursors, restorability and the immutable manifest.

ws_broadcast.note: The canonical server emits BOTH broadcast encodings on the wire. Consumers must treat both as events (never as control frames) so live fan-out and the live bus stay fed.

confirmation.note: Destructive fleet operations carry the confirmation target in this header; SDKs forward it unchanged.
